question: What is to be known brighter than bright?
premises: it is joined to Bhuvaneshas head
it is arranged in six chakras
inference: The thing joined to Bhuvaneshas head with two anangas, brighter than bright, arranged in six chakras, is to be known.
plain_english: Joined to Bhuvaneshas head with two anangas, brighter than bright, arranged in six chakras, it is to be known.
